dataset_name: AEDC Data by Statistical Areas Level 2 (SA2) 2009-2024
publisher: Australian Early Development Census / Dept of Education
geographic_identifier: 9-digit SA2 code; merged areas joined by /
purpose_in_kinderprint: Child development outcome layer; dependent construct for the priority residual model and matched-pair comparison
variables_selected: n_children; vulnerable_n/pct; at_risk_n/pct; on_track_n/pct across 5 domains, 3 summary measures and 3 health subdomains
known_limitations: Child counts ARE published, enabling CIs and significance testing. Suppression: # = 3 or fewer children assessed; * = <15 valid scores or <2 teachers or <80% coverage. 13 Greater Melbourne rows are merged SA2 groups. Assignment is residence-based (confirmed). Median community has 122 children, so 95% CI is about +/-7 points.

dataset_name: ASGS Edition 3 - SA2 digital boundaries and Main Structure
publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics
purpose_in_kinderprint: Geographic backbone; join target for all tabular sources; geometry for dissolve, zonal statistics and choropleths
variables_selected: SA2_CODE_2021, SA2_NAME_2021, SA3/SA4/GCCSA/STATE codes and names, geometry
known_limitations: CRITICAL: ABS released Edition 4 in July 2026 and it is now the default download. Edition 4 SA2 codes partially match Edition 3 and would fail silently. Edition 3 pinned explicitly. Stored EPSG:7844; all areas computed in EPSG:3577. Special-purpose SA2s carry no geometry and are excluded with a log.

dataset_name: Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas (SEIFA) 2021 - SA2 indexes
publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics
purpose_in_kinderprint: Reference against which off-trend AEDC performance is defined (priority V1); OUT-OF-SAMPLE validation of match quality since ADR-006 removed it from the matching metric
variables_selected: irsd_score, irsd_decile_aus, irsd_pct_aus, irsd_min_sa1, irsd_max_sa1 (derived: irsd_sa1_spread)
known_limitations: SEIFA 2026 not available until early 2028, so 2021 is 3 years older than AEDC 2024. IRSD is built FROM Census income/education/employment - never combined with those variables in one metric (ADR-006). ABS excludes 5 Greater Melbourne SA2s for low population; 3 are ones AEDC independently merged. Area-level measure; ecological fallacy applies.

dataset_name: 2021 Census General Community Profile DataPack, SA2, Victoria
publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics
purpose_in_kinderprint: Matching covariates (all 7 under ADR-006) and demographic context in the community profile
variables_selected: G01 population and age 0-4; G02 median age/household income/rent/household size/persons per bedroom; G32 one-parent families; G46B unemployment; G49B qualifications
known_limitations: 2026 Census first release June 2027, so 2021 is the only option. ABS randomly perturbs small cells. Growth-corridor SA2s changed materially between 2021 and the AEDC 2024 collection. Only 6 of 129 tables ingested, by design.

dataset_name: 2021 Census General Community Profile G19 long-term health conditions by age, SA2, Victoria
publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics
purpose_in_kinderprint: Child health condition context at KinderPrint reporting geography
variables_selected: Published counts and derived percentages for persons aged 0-14 reporting asthma; cancer; diabetes; heart disease; kidney disease; lung condition; mental-health condition; other long-term condition; and no long-term condition
known_limitations: Self-reported Census responses are not clinical diagnoses or incidence. The 0-14 age band cannot be split further. Respondents may report multiple conditions. ABS perturbation means small counts, including published zeroes, must not be interpreted as exact absence. Reference year 2021.

dataset_name: Metropolitan Melbourne Urban Heat Islands and Urban Vegetation 2018
publisher: Department of Transport and Planning (DELWP) with RMIT and CSIRO, Plan Melbourne Action 91
purpose_in_kinderprint: Environment domain: tree canopy and urban heat island. Environmental difference signature between matched communities. Never used as matching features.
variables_selected: PERANYTREE (adopted as vegetation indicator), UHI18_M, PERANYVEG, PERGRASS, PERSHRUB, PERTR03_10, PERTR10_15, PERTR15PL
known_limitations: 55,603 mesh blocks, EPSG:7844. UHI is mean difference in Landsat land surface temperature from a non-urban baseline; vegetation accuracy stated better than 90%. On 2016 mesh blocks vs our 2021 SA2s - harmonised by spatial overlay, not code crosswalk (ADR-005). Coverage stops at the urban boundary: 12 peri-urban communities flagged, values suppressed below 50% areal coverage. 2018 data vs AEDC 2024, defensible because the 2024 cohort was born around 2018-19.

dataset_name: Open Space (metropolitan Melbourne open space network)
publisher: Victorian Planning Authority, built from VEAC 2011 and 32 metropolitan councils
purpose_in_kinderprint: Environment domain: public open space share. Proxy for access to play environments.
variables_selected: open_space_pct (derived from filtered polygon area / community area)
known_limitations: 38,810 polygons in EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) - the file's own HA column is NOT used because Web Mercator inflates areas near Melbourne by roughly 60%; areas recomputed in EPSG:3577. Includes restricted public land and some private open space, so filtered to OS_TYPE=Public open space AND OS_ACCESS=Open AND OS_STATUS=Existing, excluding tertiary institutions, schools, golf courses, cemeteries (ADR-005). One park appears as several parcels, so polygons are dissolved before area is summed. Filename says Draft.

dataset_name: Family Maternal Child Health Centre Locations
publisher: City of Casey
purpose_in_kinderprint: Prototype child-health service location ingestion and spatial QA
variables_selected: name; address; phone; opening hours; appointment field; coordinates
known_limitations: Coverage is City of Casey only. Presence does not establish capacity, waiting time, eligibility, affordability or quality. Must not rank all Greater Melbourne localities.

dataset_name: Child and Youth Social Health Atlas of Australia: PHA workbook
publisher: PHIDU, Torrens University Australia
ASGS_edition: PHA correspondence based on ASGS 2021 SA2
purpose_in_kinderprint: Regional child-health context and data-gap assessment
variables_selected: Immunisation; long-term conditions; asthma; mental health; NDIS autism; age-specific emergency presentations for respiratory, mental, digestive, musculoskeletal, genitourinary and injury conditions
known_limitations: PHA is coarser than KinderPrint reporting localities. Values are not copied to component SA2s and are excluded from SA2 suitability scoring. Service-use measures reflect access and coding as well as health need.

dataset_name: EPA Air Watch All Sites Air Quality Hourly Averages - Yearly
publisher: Environment Protection Authority Victoria
purpose_in_kinderprint: Validated monitoring-station air-quality context
variables_selected: PM2.5; PM10; nitrogen dioxide; ozone; station coordinates; units; instrument method; validation flag; observation completeness
known_limitations: Annual station and method summaries only. Monitor readings are not copied to SA2s or treated as locality-wide exposure. Missing readings may reflect maintenance or outages. Validated negative instrument readings remain in the audit output.

dataset_name: National HealthDirect Health Facilities
publisher: Geoscience Australia using National Health Services Directory
reference_period: Active facilities at source extract date
licence: CC BY 4.0; incorporates G-NAF under its End User Licence Agreement
geographic_identifier: NHSD service identifier; G-NAF address detail PID where available
purpose_in_kinderprint: Greater Melbourne facility presence and counts
variables_selected: Active general practices; hospitals; pharmacies; organisation name; address; coordinates; NHSD service type; G-NAF PID
known_limitations: Facility presence is not capacity, accessibility, waiting time, affordability, eligibility, specialist staffing or quality. Same-SA2 counts do not capture cross-boundary access. The source does not support paediatric or other specialty classification.

dataset_name: National Pollutant Inventory - Emissions
publisher: Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
purpose_in_kinderprint: Industrial air-emission source context
variables_selected: Reporting facility; industry; PM2.5; PM10; nitrogen oxides; sulfur dioxide; carbon monoxide; VOC; benzene; formaldehyde; PAH; reported air emissions
known_limitations: NPI values are reported or estimated above activity thresholds. Facility presence and emitted mass are not ambient concentration, toxic-equivalent exposure, individual dose, compliance status or health risk. Zero selected facilities does not mean zero pollution.

dataset_name: Historical Annual Average Daily Traffic Volume - 2019
publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
purpose_in_kinderprint: Declared-road traffic-intensity context
variables_selected: Road geometry; AADT; heavy-vehicle AADT; calculation methodology
known_limitations: Covers the Victorian declared road network and 2019 traffic only. Values may be estimated or observed. The derived length-weighted measure is a traffic-intensity proxy, not noise, air pollution, child exposure or current traffic.

dataset_name: Public Transport Lines and Stops - Stops
publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
purpose_in_kinderprint: Public-transport stop availability context
variables_selected: Stop identifier; stop name; transport mode; coordinates
known_limitations: Stop counts do not measure service frequency, reliability, accessibility, capacity, affordability or travel time. Multiple platforms or modes may represent distinct stops.

dataset_name: Designated Bushfire Prone Area
publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
purpose_in_kinderprint: Designated bushfire-prone land-share context
variables_selected: Gazetted bushfire-prone-area geometry; gazettal date
known_limitations: This is a planning and building designation. The derived land share is not a property-level Bushfire Attack Level, fire probability, forecast, evacuation assessment, flood measure or personal safety advice.

dataset_name: National registers of approved education and care services
publisher: Australian Children's Education and Care Quality Authority
purpose_in_kinderprint: Early-childhood service availability
variables_selected: Approved places; service type; address; quality ratings; operating sessions; temporary-closure flag
known_limitations: Listed services and approved places do not measure vacancies, affordability, attendance, workforce, opening-hours suitability or quality of care. Unresolved addresses are excluded from spatial analysis.

dataset_name: Geocoded National Address File (G-NAF), August 2026
publisher: Geoscape Australia
purpose_in_kinderprint: Authoritative address matching and coordinates
variables_selected: Address components; G-NAF identifier; default longitude and latitude; geocode type
known_limitations: Only unique deterministic street-address matches are accepted. Ambiguous and unmatched ACECQA addresses are excluded. Not used for mailing-list creation or address-deliverability verification.

dataset_name: School Locations 2025
publisher: Victorian Department of Education - Performance and Evaluation Division
purpose_in_kinderprint: School-campus availability context
variables_selected: School identifier; school type; sector; status; address; coordinates
known_limitations: Campus presence does not measure enrolment capacity, quality, eligibility, school-zone access, travel time, disability accessibility or family preference.

dataset_name: Victoria in Future 2023 SA2 population by age and sex projections - Release 2
publisher: Victorian Department of Transport and Planning
purpose_in_kinderprint: Age-appropriate service denominators
variables_selected: Projected persons aged 0-4 and 5-9 in 2026
known_limitations: These are modelled projections rather than observed counts. Published five-year age bands do not exactly equal every service's eligibility range.

dataset_name: VCAMS child physical health and material-needs indicators
publisher: Victorian Child and Adolescent Monitoring System
purpose_in_kinderprint: Child nutrition healthy habits exposure and healthcare-needs context
variables_selected: Fruit; vegetables; physical activity; screen time; tobacco-smoke exposure; special healthcare needs; general health; food insecurity
known_limitations: Broad department areas are much larger than SA2. Survey RSE must be shown; estimates with RSE over 50% are unreliable. Data end in 2021 and are not current clinical prevalence.

dataset_name: VCAMS school-entry and maternal-child-health indicators
publisher: Victorian Child and Adolescent Monitoring System
purpose_in_kinderprint: School-entry developmental and early-life service context
variables_selected: Speech/language concern; emotional/behavioural difficulty; breastfeeding; MCH home consultation; 3.5-year MCH visit
known_limitations: LGA values are not SA2 estimates. Some MCH series end in 2017 or 2017/18 and are historical context only. NDP privacy suppression is preserved. Renamed/re-coded LGAs remain labelled as published.

dataset_name: SA2 2021 to LGA 2023 label-point allocation (Victoria)
publisher: Australian Bureau of Statistics
reference_period: ASGS Edition 3 SA2 label points; LGA 2023 boundaries
purpose_in_kinderprint: Links each SA2 to one LGA so LGA and Department-area context can be shown with its native geography
variables_selected: sa2_code_2021; sa2_name_2021; lga_code_2023; lga_name_2023; label point
known_limitations: SA2s are not nested in LGAs. Each SA2 is allocated to the LGA containing its ABS label point, so a small share of SA2 area may lie in a neighbouring LGA. Stored in data/reference/sa2_lga_2023_vic.csv.

dataset_name: Department of Families, Fairness and Housing divisions and areas map
publisher: Victorian Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
purpose_in_kinderprint: Maps the 79 Victorian LGAs to the 17 Department areas used by VCAMS survey estimates
variables_selected: department_area; lga_name (config/dffh_department_area_lgas.csv)
known_limitations: Transcribed from the published map. The map labels Loddon Campaspe as 'Loddon'; the VCAMS name is used. Area estimates remain broad-area context and are never SA2 estimates.

dataset_name: MyHospitals Data API: hospitals, emergency department, elective surgery and specialised service units
publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
reference_period: Financial year 2024-25 (latest full year per measure)
file_format: JSON via REST API (extracted to CSV)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Compare care page: hospital capability (specialised units), ED timeliness and elective surgery waits
variables_selected: Specialised service units (MYH0039); ED % seen on time by triage (MYH0010), % departed within 4 h (MYH0005), median and 90th percentile time in ED (MYH0036, MYH0013); median elective surgery wait by urgency (MYH0009)
known_limitations: Public hospitals report ED data; most private hospitals do not. Measures older than 2023-24 are dropped. Specialised units describe what a hospital has, not how many children it treats or its quality. Not a ranking.

dataset_name: Medicare-subsidised GP, allied health and specialist health care across local areas: 2017-18 to 2024-25 (2024-25 CSV)
publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
file_format: CSV in ZIP (Victorian SA3 and national rows extracted)
geographic_identifier: 5-digit SA3 code (first 5 digits of SA2 code)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Compare care page: area-average patient contribution per Medicare service and service use for GP, after-hours, specialist, psychology, speech pathology and other allied health
variables_selected: No. patients; No. services; Services per 100 people; % people with the service; Total provider fees; Total Medicare benefits paid; all persons and 0-24 years
known_limitations: Area average across all services including bulk-billed ones, by patient residence; not any practice's fee. Excludes services not billed to Medicare. n.p. values suppressed.

dataset_name: Urgent Care Clinics (Victoria) - Better Health Channel map
publisher: Victorian Department of Health (Better Health Channel)
licence: Victorian Government website content; factual listing (name, address, phone, coordinates) only
purpose_in_kinderprint: Compare care page: free walk-in urgent care options
variables_selected: Name, address, suburb and postcode, phone, Healthdirect listing link, latitude, longitude
known_limitations: 37 clinics listed at capture (page states 38 locations). Opening hours are on each Healthdirect listing, not in this feed.

dataset_name: NNDSS public datasets - influenza (laboratory confirmed) and salmonella
publisher: Australian Centre for Disease Control
file_format: xlsx (record level; aggregated to Victorian month x age group in extraction)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Seasons page: which months influenza and salmonella peak for Victorian children
variables_selected: Notifications by week-ending month, state and five-year age group
known_limitations: Notifications reflect testing as well as illness; 2020-2021 excluded as COVID-19 years. RSV is not in the public datasets. State level only, not SA2.

dataset_name: OpenStreetMap fresh-food outlets, Greater Melbourne
publisher: OpenStreetMap contributors (via Overpass API)
file_format: JSON via Overpass API (extracted to CSV)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Nutrition report: supermarkets, greengrocers, butchers, bakeries, markets and organic-tagged shops near the suburb
variables_selected: Name, shop or amenity type, organic tag, address, opening hours, coordinates
known_limitations: Volunteer-mapped: outlets can be missing; organic tag is rarely recorded; no prices or stock.

dataset_name: Australian Food Composition Database Release 3 - Nutrient profiles
publisher: Food Standards Australia New Zealand
file_format: xlsx (selected nutrient columns extracted to CSV)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Nutrition report: everyday foods richest in iron, calcium, fibre, vitamin C, zinc, iodine and vitamin D
variables_selected: Energy, protein, fat, fibre, sugars, calcium, iodine, iron, magnesium, potassium, sodium, zinc, vitamin A, folate, vitamin C, vitamin D, long-chain omega-3 per 100 g
known_limitations: Per 100 g, not per serve. Ingredients used in small amounts are excluded from the child food lists.

dataset_name: Victorian council immunisation sessions
publisher: Melbourne Vaccine Education Centre (MVEC), Murdoch Children's Research Institute
licence: Public reference page; council names, links and phone numbers only
geographic_identifier: Council name, matched to ABS LGA 2023 name
purpose_in_kinderprint: Vaccines page: link each SA2 to its council immunisation sessions (booking page and phone)
variables_selected: Council name; immunisation page URL; phone (immunisation team line where listed, otherwise main line)
known_limitations: 78 councils listed (31 metropolitan, 47 regional). Session days, times and venues are on each council page, not in this table. The MVEC page names Hume City Council as "Hume Bay City Council"; the official name is used here. Stored in data/reference/council_immunisation_vic.csv.

dataset_name: Vicmap Features of Interest: playgrounds, picnic sites, day visitor areas and swimming pools
publisher: Victorian Government, Department of Transport and Planning (Vicmap)
purpose_in_kinderprint: Play today: playgrounds, pools and picnic areas near the suburb, and play-space access for practitioners
variables_selected: Feature subtype, name, parent place name, coordinates
known_limitations: Presence only: shade, fencing, toilets, size and condition are not recorded; about a quarter of playgrounds have no name.
